visual_goal: Show the support platform with bought channels and agent desktop on one side, and the marketplace-owned case service, context read model and recovery decisioning on the other, moving money through domain APIs and the ledger.
prompt: A left-to-right architecture illustration split into two soft background panels. Left panel, light grey, labeled 'Bought': a box 'Channels' with small chat, phone and e-mail icons, from which two arrows lead to 'AI assistant' and 'Agent desktop'. Right panel, light teal, labeled 'Marketplace': a large central box 'Case service' receiving one arrow from 'AI assistant' and one from 'Agent desktop'. Above it, a box 'Events' with one arrow down into 'Case service' labeled 'proactive cases'. From 'Case service', one arrow up-right to 'Context read model' and one arrow right to 'Recovery decisioning'. From 'Recovery decisioning', one arrow right to 'Domain APIs' labeled 'refund, rebook' and one arrow down to an open book 'Ledger'. On the far left, an unlabeled generic guest figure with one arrow into 'Channels'.
alt: Bought channels, an AI assistant and an agent desktop feed a marketplace-owned case service, which also opens proactive cases from events, reads a context model and calls recovery decisioning, which acts through domain APIs and posts to the ledger.

visual_goal: Show the stays case state machine, with 'With partner' as a state on its own deadline that moves the case back to the marketplace when missed.
prompt: A state diagram of rounded boxes. Left to right: 'New', then 'Triaged', joined by an arrow labeled 'driver and clock'. From 'Triaged', two arrows fan right: one up to 'With marketplace' (top row) and one down to an orange box 'With partner' (bottom row), which carries a small alarm clock. One arrow from 'With partner' straight up into 'With marketplace', labeled 'deadline missed'. From 'With partner', one arrow right into a green box 'Resolved', and from 'With marketplace' one arrow right into 'Resolved'. From 'Resolved', one arrow right into a grey box 'Closed'. Above the top row, a box 'Reopened' sits above 'Resolved': one arrow up from 'Resolved' into 'Reopened', and one arrow from 'Reopened' left and down into 'With marketplace'. No arrow enters 'With partner' except from 'Triaged'.
alt: Case states New, Triaged, With marketplace and With partner, where a missed partner deadline moves the case to the marketplace, both leading to Resolved, then Closed or Reopened back to the marketplace.

visual_goal: Show King's Day on the target design as swimlanes: an inventory signal opens the case, the hotel confirms, recovery decisioning books linked replacements, guests hear the evening before, and the ledger records payable and receivable.
prompt: A left-to-right swimlane diagram with six horizontal lanes stacked top to bottom, each labeled at its left edge: 'Inventory', 'Case service', 'Hotel', 'Recovery', 'Guest', 'Ledger'. Time runs left to right. Each message is one short straight vertical arrow between two lanes, with no boxes and no people, in this order from left to right: first, an arrow DOWN from 'Inventory' to 'Case service' labeled 'negative headroom'; second, an arrow DOWN from 'Case service' to 'Hotel' labeled 'confirm walks'; third, an arrow UP from 'Hotel' to 'Case service' labeled '4 reservations'; fourth, an arrow DOWN from 'Case service' to 'Recovery' labeled 'entitlement'; fifth, a small circular loop arrow inside the 'Recovery' lane labeled 'linked replacements'; sixth, an arrow DOWN from 'Recovery' to 'Guest' labeled 'the evening before'; seventh, an arrow DOWN from 'Recovery' to 'Ledger' labeled 'receivable'. A soft evening sky tint with a small crescent moon shades the background behind the last two arrows. Write every label as plain text without quotation marks.
alt: Swimlanes for inventory, case service, hotel, recovery, guest and ledger: a negative-headroom signal opens a case, the hotel confirms 4 reservations, recovery decisioning books linked replacements, the guests hear the evening before and the ledger records the receivable.
